sections.markdown:
## F — Structured research index and consolidated VERIFY list: pedestrians, school buses, emergency vehicles and traffic stops
Knowledge facts: part C holds 44 fact blocks (sec07-F01 onward) from physical pages 48 to 53; part C2 holds 10 confusable-pair blocks (sec07-R01 onward).
Exam authority: part A states issuer, handbook revision and test structure; question count, passing score and time limit are unknown.
VERIFY list:
- NC-PED-A-EXAM — knowledge-test question count, passing score and time limit not printed in the handbook (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- NC-PED-MARKET — market pack unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
- NC-PED-TEARDOWN — competitive teardown unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
Dynamic facts: school bus hours are typical times, and traffic-stop procedures and fines (for example sec07-F02, sec07-F15) can change; confirm against current North Carolina law.

corpus_stability.reason: The handbook prints a single revision date (Revised May 2025) on its back cover and states laws and fees are subject to change by the General Assembly; no sign of more than one revision per year in the selected pages.
